name: SkillRegistry::approve_repo_skill

test_list.description: Repository skills remain unapproved and cannot replace a user-global skill by name.
A witness restores approval for the exact source digest and a changed source becomes stale.
Changed skill content invalidates the index and requires rediscovery.

inputs.name: approval
inputs.description: Trusted approval whose evidence digest equals the indexed skill source digest.

output_description: Marks only the approved repository source digest trusted.
